methodology.prototypeCommand: npx vitest bench --run .tmp/udomdiff-keyed-experiment.bench.ts -t 'swap one adjacent pair' --reporter=verbose
methodology.productionCommand: npm run benchmark:keyed -- --reporter=verbose -t 'swap one adjacent pair'
methodology.unit: milliseconds per operation; lower is faster
methodology.prototypeScope: DOM-only movement with identical keyed element identities; correctness checked for order and identity
methodology.limitations: The prototype excludes template binding work and layout/paint. The production harness includes Gluon template reconciliation but reports candidate-only results here; no cross-commit production baseline was inferred.
